title: Members
lede: Who is in this group. Every screen that names a person - a debtor, a creditor, a filter, an answer - reads this list, so a member missing here is a person those screens can only show as an identifier.

list.cardDescription: Recorded membership, in the order people joined. The role is recorded rather than enforced: nothing in this build consults it yet.
list.caption: Members of this group
list.name: Name
list.empty: Nobody is a member yet. Record somebody below, and they can be named in a commitment.

add.cardDescription: Adds somebody to this group, so other screens can name them. Recording the same person twice is the same person: the group keeps one membership.
add.userIdHint: The person's identifier, as a uuid - for example 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111. There is no directory to pick from yet, so this is the handle.
add.displayNameHint: What the group calls them. There is nobody to look a name up in, so this is the name.
add.roleHint: Recorded, not enforced: a build without identity has no admin whose word the role would weigh more than a member's.
add.recorded: {name} is a member of this group now.

invite.cardDescription: Make a code the next member can use to join. The code lasts seven days and can be used by anyone who has it, as often as they like - so send it to the people you mean to, and let it expire rather than passing it around.
invite.expires: Usable until {when}, then it stops working.
invite.noLimit: This code has no limit on how many times it can be used. It stops when it expires, and not before.

share.cardTitle: A link somebody can look through
share.cardDescription: For somebody who needs to see what the group owes whom and will never be a member of it: an accountant, a landlord, a mediator. It shows the positions and the names the group recorded, and it joins nobody - there is no way to accept it, and no screen behind it can change anything.
share.warning: Whoever holds this link can read those numbers, and a link is easy to forward. It stops working when the window above closes; this build cannot revoke one earlier, so a group that needs that makes a new link rather than taking an old one back.
